releases.headline: Production-ready grind workflows and fail-safe recovery.
releases.summary: Connected conservation, Target Projects, workflow building, Player Picks, analytics and complete destructive recovery to the live extension path.
details: Soft fodder reserves now rank production solver results without turning valid SBCs into false impossibilities.
Added Target Project import/sync, five workflow templates, nested editing and Legacy Sequence migration with stable IDs.
Added conservative controller-level Player Pick reading and selection with explicit pause on incomplete or ambiguous state.
All destructive steps persist exact intents and reconcile completed, not-applied and ambiguous reload states before any retry.
Added capability health, inventory rating buckets, per-run rating-flow analytics and structured configuration views.
Added 20-iteration fake-EA recovery coverage, a Chromium integration harness, deterministic packaging and CI release artifacts.

releases.headline: Fail-closed workflow and reward hardening.
releases.summary: Hardened GrindPilot state ownership, destructive recovery, protected-card handling, reward correlation and player identity.
details: Moved runtime state behind typed service-worker commands with serialized revisions and per-tab run ownership.
Verified the full content-script bootstrap and added immediate safe run recovery after the previous owner tab closes.
Blocked ambiguous destructive resumes and unverified unassigned or reward-pack states.
Preserved complete profile limits and hidden protection settings from load through Start.
Prevented locked cards and base/promo versions of the same footballer from being consumed incorrectly.
Required-special stop conditions now use fresh normalized inventory and optional card-type filters.
Added focused regression and browser-harness coverage for the hardened paths.

releases.headline: A clean blue identity for GrindPilot.
releases.summary: Added an original navigation-loop icon that stays recognizable from the toolbar to the extensions page.
details: Added purpose-rendered 16, 32, 48 and 128 pixel PNG icons.
Added a scalable source master and automated manifest icon validation.
The artwork is original and uses no EA, FIFA, FC, FUT, club or player branding.

releases.headline: GrindPilot FC26 unified grind-manager MVP.
releases.summary: Added one persistent workflow UI for solving, submitting, claiming, opening owned rewards, resolving items and safely repeating.
details: Added explicit REVIEW, ASSISTED and hash-approved AUTO workflow modes with pause, resume, stop and recovery.
Added item-aware inventory, duplicate and SBC Storage policies with no implicit quicksell.
Added protected-card, high-rating, reserve and arbitrary Target Project policies.
Added safe reward-pack correlation, player-pick pause behavior, profiles, activity logs and opt-in diagnostics.
Source code: https://github.com/Matchekk/Matchek-s-FUT-Magic

releases.headline: AutoSBC Best-of: hardened local-first release.
releases.summary: Combined AutoPilot's extension runtime with selected Auto-SBC policies and fixed critical solver and bridge failures.
details: Unknown requirements, undersized player pools, and max/exact zero constraints now fail closed.
Added duplicate, storage, untradeable, and preferred-player value policies.
Hardened the extension bridge, FUT.GG deadlines, manifest scope, and solver readiness checks.
Added regression tests, CI, privacy documentation, and complete GPL/MIT provenance.
Source code: https://github.com/Matchekk/Matchek-s-FUT-Magic

releases.headline: Smarter solver efficiency and card type controls.
releases.summary: Improved solver efficiency and added clearer control over which card types the solver can use.
details: Added solved squad player pricing.
Improved solver efficiency so it should use less high rated player anchors.
Added card type pickers to the single, multi, and sequence solvers.

releases.headline: Improved sequence solver panel and solving algorithm.
releases.summary: Added a review before submit mode as an option in the sequence solver.
details: Added a review before submit mode as an option in the sequence solver.
improved sequence solvers algorthim to deal with complex chem challenges.

releases.headline: Improved fetching speeds.
releases.summary: Made player fetching much more efficient and take less time.
details: Made player fetching much more efficient and take less time.
Minor imrpovement to solver logic to fix a small regression.

releases.headline: TOTS solver fix
releases.summary: Improved solver logic to recognise TOTS requirements and club players.
details: Improved solver logic to recognise TOTS requirements and club players.
Added a button to quickly view the extensions source code in the global settings menu.

releases.headline: Solver and player pool fixes
releases.summary: Improved solver logic and fixed the SBC Storage and Use Unassigned settings.
details: Improved solver logic so it handles SBCs more reliably.
Fixed Only Storage so it properly uses players that match your SBC storage.
Fixed Use Unassigned so unassigned players can be fetched, solved with, and applied correctly.
Derivative source and upstream attribution: https://github.com/Matchekk/Matchek-s-FUT-Magic

releases.headline: More reliable solving and smarter fetching
releases.summary: Made the solver more reliable, improved player fetching, and cleaned up small UI details.
details: Added a better fallback flow so the solver recovers more reliably solve difficult challenges.
Improved player fetching to allow for more intelligent triggers.
Made small UI improvements and cleanup tweaks.

releases.headline: Fixes and patching
releases.summary: Cleaned up recent issues and patched smaller rough edges across the extension.
details: Added a ratings slider to the sequence solver
Made small UI tweaks for consistency.
Fixed multi solver not syncing with global settings.

releases.headline: Sequence Solver fixes
releases.summary: Improved Sequence Solver feedback, progress, and hub reliability.
details: Made failure messages clearer.
Progress now updates during active solve phases.
Improved handling for refreshed or relisted SBC challenges.
Fixed the missing Sequence Solver button bug in the SBC tab.

releases.headline: Better sequence runs and easier solver control
releases.summary: Made Sequence Solver easier to follow and added more control over who the solver can use.
details: Sequence Solver now shows the exact players used for each completed challenge.
Sequence Solver now lets you flip through completed challenge entries inside the execution panel.
Added local league and nation exclusions so you can block or allow them for a specific solve without changing your global settings.
TOTW cards can now be controlled separately from the main special-card filter.
Fixed exclusion panels so they show the right blocked items, stay in sync, and scroll properly.

releases.headline: Sequence Solver is live
releases.summary: Plan and solve multiple SBCs in one run.
details: Added the new Sequence Solver.
Save sequence plans and run them in order.
Added plan loops, step loops, and execution progress.

releases.headline: Changelog and update notes
releases.summary: Added a changelog popup for installs and updates.
details: Added a changelog popup after installs and updates.
Added a Changelog button in Settings.
Saved viewed status so it only opens once per version.

releases.headline: Speed and solver improvements
releases.summary: Improved player lookup and squad applying speed.
details: Improved player and squad applying speed.
Improved set and multi-solve stability.
